name: Kunio Kusayama
source: A computer programmer who ended up in the mansion after an alcohol binge. He invites Shin'ichi to drink in his room leading to them both collapsing from the amount of alcohol drunk. His main activities are to fantasize about the girls in the mansion and finding another substance to imbibe.
